about: As the principal attorney at The Tucker Law Firm, PLLC, based in Edmonds, Washington, Lee Tucker represents individuals and families in a broad range of personal injury and civil litigation matters. His practice focuses on general personal injury claims, motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, brain injury, premises liability, medical malpractice, birth injury, delayed or incorrect diagnosis, and informed consent cases. Throughout his career, he has remained committed to helping injured clients pursue the justice and financial compensation they deserve after suffering life-altering injuries caused by the negligence of others.

Mr. Tucker has built a reputation for providing dedicated advocacy in complex personal injury and medical malpractice litigation. Drawing on years of experience, he works closely with clients to understand the full impact of their injuries and develop legal strategies tailored to their individual circumstances. Whether negotiating with insurance companies or presenting cases in court, he is committed to protecting the rights of those he represents and pursuing favorable outcomes through settlement or trial when necessary.

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Tucker has achieved a long record of securing significant verdicts and multimillion-dollar settlements on behalf of his clients. His success reflects his thorough preparation, attention to detail and determination to hold negligent individuals, businesses and institutions accountable. He understands the physical, emotional and financial challenges that often accompany serious injuries and strives to provide compassionate guidance while pursuing meaningful results for every client.

Mr. Tucker earned his Juris Doctor from the University of Dayton School of Law after completing his undergraduate studies at Swarthmore College. He was admitted to practice law in Washington in 2000 and later gained admission in Kentucky in 2009. In addition, he is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington, allowing him to represent clients in both state and federal courts when appropriate.

Active in the legal community, Mr. Tucker maintains memberships in several respected professional organizations that reflect his commitment to continued professional development and effective advocacy. He is a member of the Kentucky Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, the Kentucky Justice Association, the Washington State Association for Justice and the Trial Lawyers College.
